主要内容: On March 17, 2021, Paul Licon, Chief Financial Officer and Chief Accounting Officer of Impac Mortgage Holdings, Inc., announced his resignation effective March 31, 2021, to pursue other opportunities. There were no disagreements or issues with Mr. Licon regarding the Company’s operations, financial, regulatory, accounting policies, or internal control systems. Jon Gloeckner, Senior Vice President Treasury and Financial Reporting, will assume the duties of principal financial officer and principal accounting officer starting April 1, 2021, until a permanent replacement is named. Mr. Gloeckner has been with the Company since 2004 and has held various roles, including treasury, financial reporting, and accounting. The Company is continuing its search for a new Chief Financial Officer through a national search firm. There are no family relationships between Mr. Gloeckner and any director or executive officer of the Company.
